presentation.label: GENERATIVE
presentation.summary: Shape an editable sample phrase directly on both native SRC pages.
presentation.overview: VECTOR commits real trigs and PTCH/HOLD/VOL locks as its SRC parameters change. The native sequencer plays the result immediately. SRC SETUP holds secondary controls. Physical hardware is untested; the owner approved release using the recorded emulator evidence while their Octatrack is in repair.
highlights: Two native SRC pages with twelve controls
Real editable trigs and note locks
usage: Select an audio track. Open SRC page 2 (double-tap SRC), choose VECTOR and press YES. In the backing-pool modal, highlight STATIC or FLEX with UP/DOWN or LEVEL, then press RIGHT to enter that pool. YES also opens the highlighted pool; YES on a loaded sample slot assigns that pool and sample to VECTOR. Use the corresponding stock sample-slot and file-loading tools to load a tuned sample; NO returns from the sample browser.

Double-tap the assigned TRACK to reopen the pool modal. LEFT returns to the machine list; RIGHT on VECTOR opens the modal. RIGHT in the pool modal opens the highlighted Static/Flex sample list. In a sample-slot list, LEFT returns to pool choice and RIGHT opens the stock file browser. Horizontal arrows navigate menus without changing the assigned pool; YES on a sample slot commits the pool and sample.
Press SRC for TYPE, DENS, ROOT, SCAL, GATE and ACNT on encoders A–F. Turn a parameter to commit a phrase immediately, including during playback. The current seed stays fixed while shaping the vector.
Open SRC page 2 with a double tap on SRC. Encoders A–F adjust SEED, SPAN, OFST, ROT, RPT and DIR. These changes also commit immediately; press SRC to return.

Press PLAY to hear the native sequencer repeat the phrase. Push LEVEL on SRC for the ordinary sample controls, then use grid recording and a held trig to edit PTCH. AMP exposes the generated HOLD/VOL locks. Push LEVEL again to return.
Press YES on the generator for a new seed and variation. STOP/PLAY preserves a populated phrase. Select normal FLEX/STATIC to remove VECTOR while retaining the generated pattern.

controls.name: TYPE
controls.doc: 0–15. Low values favor varied scale notes; higher values prefer tonic/fifth and stronger beat positions. Original algorithm; not a byte-identical Sting port.

controls.name: DENS
controls.doc: 0–16. Note count is round(motif length × DENS / 16). Zero is silence; 16 fills the motif. Changes commit immediately with the current seed.

controls.name: ROOT
controls.doc: C–B. Sample reference is C at neutral PTCH. Tune the source sample accordingly. Pitch locks stay within −12 to +12 semitones.

controls.name: SCAL
controls.doc: Chromatic, natural minor, major, Dorian or minor pentatonic. All generated pitches remain in the selected scale.

controls.name: GATE
controls.doc: 0–126 in native AMP HOLD units, not percent or milliseconds. Generated HOLD locks range from half to all of this value. AMP REL still shapes the audible tail.

controls.name: ACNT
controls.doc: 0–127. Strong notes keep the Part AMP VOL. Other notes are attenuated by up to half; zero gives equal volumes. This writes AMP VOL locks, not MIDI velocity.

controls.name: SEED
controls.doc: 0–127. Select the deterministic variation; YES advances and wraps this value. Other parameter edits keep it fixed.

controls.name: SPAN
controls.doc: 0–12 semitones either side of OFST, clipped to the native ±12-semitone range. Pitches remain in the selected scale; an empty window uses its nearest scale note.

controls.name: OFST
controls.doc: Displayed as −12 to +12 semitones; stored midpoint 12 means zero. Moves the center of the pitch window.

controls.name: ROT
controls.doc: 0–63 steps. Rotate the generated phrase right within the native track length.

controls.name: RPT
controls.doc: OFF (0) uses the full native track length. 1–64 chooses a repeating motif; larger values are clipped to the active length.

controls.name: DIR
controls.doc: FWD or REV. Reverse the generated phrase before applying ROT.

limitations: MKI/MKII hardware support is unverified; documentation captures use the MKII emulator panel.
Shares machine chooser hooks with Analog BD and FM Synth; the configurator and native builder reject those combinations.
Sample must be tuned to the stated C reference. Generated pitch is limited to the native ±12-semitone range.
Parameter edits and YES publish during playback. Custom Undo and bar-quantized replacement are not implemented.
Uses native pattern/track length, speed and swing. RPT sets a motif length within that track; no independent clock, swing or MIDI output.
SRC generation knobs are request parameters, not p-lock/LFO/scene destinations. The normal EDIT view retains native playback controls.

Generation owns note trigs, PTCH/HOLD/VOL locks and note timing/conditions. Every changed generator parameter or YES replaces those across the current track; other locks, recorder events and swing are preserved.
The DRAM loader reserves 1,707 audio pages (10,487,808 bytes) shared across DRAM modules.

Physical hardware, save/reload and power-cycle persistence, audio continuity and mixed-module maximum-load playback have not been tested. The owner waived current-build hardware testing for this exact release.
ColdFire resource pricing is a conditional static model, not measured chip timing. See TESTING.md for event-rate and memory-service assumptions.

resources.recorded: 2026-10-06; isolated compilation, static accounting and emulator probes

storage.label: Storage
storage.conditions: The platform reserves 1,707 audio pages shared by every DRAM module. VECTOR alone occupies 24,604 bytes of linked runtime within that arena. Native borrowed memory and flash append are counted separately in qualification.

processing.label: CPU / DSP load
processing.conditions: Conditional 32-cycle/instruction pricing, 700,000-instruction commit ceiling, eight startup commits plus 6,000,000-cycle stock UI/scheduling reserve; one full burst per second at 264 MHz. Not measured chip timing or audio headroom.

impact.conditions: One 1–64-step phrase per parameter edit or YES, with first-PLAY empty-track filling. Runs on the UI task and publishes through native live track updates. Stock Flex/Static playback and DSP are retained; no utilization/headroom percentage is asserted.

cpu.rationale: Generation runs on the UI task. A synthetic native commit peaks at 472,499 executed instructions; the conditional model also bounds full all-track lock rebuilding. Physical timing and mixed-module audio load are unmeasured.

dsp.rationale: No added DSP kernel. Generated note density still changes ordinary sample/FX workload, which must be stress-tested.

memory.rationale: The shared loader reserves 10,487,808 audio-pool bytes. VECTOR has one shared runtime/staging buffer, bounded UI stack and reuses native pattern/settings/window capacities. No added DSP buffers or new heap allocations.

tests.summary: Firmware-free core: 244,800 deterministic/scale/density and 29,772 secondary-control cases passed ASan/UBSan. Current emulator walks pass all twelve immediate SRC commits, native transport, Static/Flex modal and stock sample loading, with other-track preservation. ColdFire instruction/stack probes and conditional static bounds are recorded. Physical hardware remains untested and owner-waived for this release; persistence and audio stress are not claimed.
gates: Firmware-free sanitizer generator, writer and packed-settings checks
Authored C/hooks to assembly reproducibility without firmware
Current native SRC and sample-pool emulator behavior walks
ColdFire instruction/stack probe and conditional resource accounting
Browser/native build parity and matching composition rejection
Exact-version owner hardware waiver; physical unit unavailable

conditions.parameterExtremes: Firmware-free sanitizer matrix covers all roots/scales/pitch windows and all secondary-control domains. Native instruction probe: 3,840 length/type/scale/seed cases and eight full native commit calls; static loop ceilings cover 64 steps and 2,016 rank shifts.
conditions.parameterModulation: Generator controls are request parameters, not LFO/p-lock/scene destinations. UI knob changes and YES synchronously publish stock trigs and locks; ordinary sample playback modulation remains native.
conditions.modeSwitching: Focused emulator: PLAY, STOP/restart, both SRC pages, native EDIT, held trig, both backing kinds, repeated horizontal menu navigation and cancellation. Save/reload, Part copy and power-cycle persistence remain untested.
conditions.maxLoad: Eight signed audio tracks may auto-fill on one PLAY edge. Conditional UI budget allows one such burst per second at 264 MHz; no audio-thread work is added. Stock rendering/scheduling uses the explicit reserve. Mixed-module audio stress is not measured.
conditions.inputConditions: Original integer generator is input-independent. Density up to 64 notes/track; native lock rebuild scans every audio/MIDI lane. Audio sample/FX costs remain stock and are outside the added UI-work bound; hardware audio continuity is untested.

regions.name: Shared DRAM platform arena: code/data, packed staging and unused capacity
Platform flash append: loader, packed runtime and platform metadata
Additional bounded UI stack capacity, including native callees
Reused native list window, two surfaces, descriptor and callbacks
Sixteen pattern records in loaded bank and SRAM mirror
Twelve settings bytes across four Parts, loaded bank and SRAM mirror

memory.conditions: VECTOR alone with stock FX2, static stock descriptors, XBUS=1 SPEC=1 DEV=0 BUILD=98. Arena includes the entire aligned 24,604-byte linked runtime and packed staging; counted once. Native pattern/settings/UI/lock-index capacities are borrowed and counted explicitly, not new allocations. The stock window constructor uses fixed slots and preallocated surfaces; new heap bytes are zero. Stack ceiling includes 1,048 observed bytes on a full commit plus 168-byte UI wrapper/caller allowance. No new DSP code, state, delay lines or audio buffers. See TESTING.md for exact section/frame and range accounting.

hardware.reason: Owner explicitly approved release using the current emulator evidence on 6 October 2026 because their Octatrack is in repair. This waives current-build physical hardware testing only; software behavior, source packaging, resource accounting and browser/native parity remain required.

license.declaration: Original VECTOR C generator, tests, documentation and vector illustration by Octamod contributors. Native registration/input-layer interoperability is adapted from MIT octabam; Sam Banks and existing component notices are retained. Iftah’s Sting 2 is musical inspiration; no Sting source, branding artwork or assets were copied and no exact algorithm or endorsement is claimed. Firmware and extracted routines are excluded; replay bytes are reconstructed only from verified local firmware into temporary build output.
